clean_repro.probe: POST /v2/vectordb/entities/upsert with JSON field containing invalid string value

contract_refs: dataType constraint: milvus_type_json_001 asserts JSON is a valid scalar dataType

source_grounding.call_chain_traced: REST v2 Upsert -> handler_v2.upsert() -> anyToColumns() -> case DataType_JSON: type assertion to []byte WITHOUT JSON validation
source_grounding.note: 源码接地发现: JSON字段在anyToColumns函数中(line 1968)直接做candi.v.Interface().([]byte)类型断言,未做JSON格式校验。输入'invalid_json_string'字符串被直接转换为[]byte存储,没有json.Marshal或validation检查。

falsification.observed: HTTP 200, data=[{"id":0,"meta":"invalid_json_string"}] - invalid string stored as-is, confirming the bug

cognition_match.developer_quote: REST v2 API fails to properly serialize/deserialize complex data types - Returns wrong values for large integers, Array fields in raw protobuf format, AutoId not working for Int64 PK, Incorrect JSON for JSON field
cognition_match.note: 命中developer_cognition.json中rest-v2-data-type-handling模式(26个历史案例),属于REST v2 API数据类型序列化/反序列化缺陷集群

contract.explicit_requirement: JSON is a valid dataType (constraint_id: milvus_type_json_001) but NO explicit constraint requiring JSON format validation

physical.objective_constraint: JSON field has objective semantic constraint: value MUST be valid JSON (object/array/string/number/boolean/null)

perspective_analysis.aggregation_applied: verdict_B=CONFIRMED (physical constraint violated) + verdict_C=CONFIRMED (no graceful handling) → final=CONFIRMED

verdicts.rationale: REST v2 upsert接受JSON字段的非法值('invalid_json_string'字符串而非JSON对象)并成功存储,违反了JSON字段的客观语义约束。源码接地发现anyToColumns函数在处理DataType_JSON时(line 1968)直接做类型断言candi.v.Interface().([]byte),未进行JSON格式验证。查询证实非法字符串被原样存储。此缺陷属于developer_cognition.json中识别的'rest-v2-data-type-handling'模式(26个历史案例),是该类REST v2数据类型处理缺陷集群的实例。
